title: Residual window: the server loses the event store after the payment ran
label: after-inbox-store-off

observations.name: the residual window was hit
observations.expected: at least one payment committed while its server could not store its event
observations.observed: 3 of 3 payments committed before the cut had no event at the heal: [s18-after-inbox-store-off-0aa1b4-slowpay-cina-4, s18-after-inbox-store-off-0aa1b4-slowpay-australia-nz-3, s18-after-inbox-store-off-0aa1b4-slowpay-india-5]

observations.name: a payment whose event could not be stored is not executed again
observations.expected: 0 extra executions: the retry is answered from the outcome recorded with the payment (G5 inbox)
observations.expectedBeforeFix: the saga's retry runs the payment again (G5 residual window): attempts = 2
observations.observed: 3 extra execution(s) among the 3 in the window; 3 overall; attempts {s18-after-inbox-store-off-0aa1b4-slowpay-cina-4=2, s18-after-inbox-store-off-0aa1b4-slowpay-india-5=2, s18-after-inbox-store-off-0aa1b4-slowpay-australia-nz-3=2, s18-after-inbox-store-off-0aa1b4-slowpay-india-2=1, s18-after-inbox-store-off-0aa1b4-slowpay-cina-1=1, s18-after-inbox-store-off-0aa1b4-slowpay-australia-nz-6=1}

observations.name: every payment is stored exactly once
observations.expected: one PaymentProcessedEvent per order once the saga's retries are done
observations.observed: 0 order(s) without the event after 300 s, 0 with two; events {s18-after-inbox-store-off-0aa1b4-slowpay-cina-1=1, s18-after-inbox-store-off-0aa1b4-slowpay-india-2=1, s18-after-inbox-store-off-0aa1b4-slowpay-australia-nz-3=1, s18-after-inbox-store-off-0aa1b4-slowpay-cina-4=1, s18-after-inbox-store-off-0aa1b4-slowpay-india-5=1, s18-after-inbox-store-off-0aa1b4-slowpay-australia-nz-6=1}

completed them: the saga pays each one (the handler answers 4000 ms after its commit)
